aarti.tek: Victory to Mother Pārvatī, victory to Mother Pārvatī.
You are Brahman, the eternal Goddess, the giver of auspicious fruit.
aarti.pad1: You destroy the lotus-like clans of your enemies; victory to you, protector of your servants.
You are the life of the world, the Mother of the world; Hari and Hara (Viṣṇu and Śiva) sing your praises.
aarti.pad2: Your lion mount looks splendid, and you wear earrings as well.
The wives of the gods sing your glory and dance to the beat of tā-thā.
aarti.pad3: In the Satya age, most beautiful in form and character, you were known by the name Satī.
Born in the house of Himācala, you delighted in the company of your friends.
aarti.pad4: You tore apart Śumbha and Niśumbha, you who dwell on the Himālaya;
taking on a body with a thousand arms, you took the discus in your hand.
aarti.pad5: You yourself are the form of creation, Mother, steeped in love with Śiva.
Nandī and Bhṛṅgī have taken up the vīṇā, and the whole world is rapt with joy.
aarti.pad6: The gods make their plea and bring it to your heart;
clapping again and again, they sing, their hearts steeped in love.
aarti.pad7: Śrī Pratāp says: whoever sings the Mother's āratī
is ever happy, day after day, and gains happiness and wealth.
